series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): On Whale Island, twelve-year-old Gon Freecss dreams of taking the perilous Hunter Exam, but Aunt Mito forbids it unless he completes an impossible challenge: catching the mythical Lord of the Swamp. Perched in a giant tree with his father's rod, Gon battles the colossal monster fish and lands it before the stunned villagers, proving his unshakable resolve.
Prior events (Part 2): Having conquered the swamp, Gon claims Ging's fishing rod from Aunt Mito. Mito confesses that his father chose the Hunter's life over raising him, expecting tears, but Gon is inspired to discover what makes hunting so magnificent. Promising to return as the greatest Hunter in the world, Gon boards the passenger ship and sets sail toward the open ocean.
Prior events (Part 3): Out on the turbulent sea, a ferocious storm violently rolls the passenger vessel, incapacitating dozens of hopeful applicants with agonizing seasickness. Amid the groaning wreckage in the hold, only Kurapika, Leorio, and Gon remain totally unaffected. Observing the cabin, the grizzled sea Captain recognizes their extraordinary resilience and summons them into his quarters.
Prior events (Part 4): In the captain's quarters, the Captain reveals he is an official examiner and demands to know why each candidate seeks to become a Hunter. Kurapika explains his tragic mission to avenge the massacred Kurta clan and retrieve their stolen Scarlet Eyes, while Leorio brazenly insists money is all that matters. Enraged by Leorio's cynical disrespect, Kurapika challenges him to a duel out on the stormy deck.
Prior events (Part 5): Out on the rain-lashed deck, Kurapika unholsters his twin wooden swords while Leorio flicks open a switchblade. As lightning flashes and their blades prepare to clash, a monstrous rogue wave breaks the rigging and hurls a young deckhand into the churning sea. Without hesitation, Gon leaps completely off the ship into mid-air, risking his life to grab the falling sailor.
